content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silky blouse with a relaxed fit, knee-length hem, vibrant crimson red (#DC143C), crepe de Chine; tailored wide-leg trousers in matching crimson red (#DC143C), full length, wool blend; pointed-toe flats in soft brown leather. This ensemble strikes the perfect balance between effortlessness and intentionality for a Sunday afternoon park stroll and coffee date. The monochromatic crimson palette fulfills her specific wish for something red while maintaining a relaxed, home-category formality suitable for a first meeting. By choosing breathable natural fabrics like crepe and wool, the outfit remains comfortable against the autumn breeze without feeling overdressed or too formal for a casual outdoor setting."}
